deadline.value: Annual call (bando). The 2026/27 (42nd cycle) call closed May 20, 2026, 1 pm (2025/26: May 13, 2025); a smaller summer call for extra places closed Aug 26, 2026. The 2027/28 (43rd cycle) call is not yet published.

also.quote: passing an admission examination, which is announced annually

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: Admission is by competition, and the FAQ says a supervisor need not be contacted first; the Academic Board assigns one within four months. Applicants still finishing a master's co-sign a thesis summary with a supervisor.
supervisor.quote: It is not necessary; in general, the supervisor will be assigned by the Academic Board within four months

funding.value: Each course lists its number of places and scholarships; some places are awarded without a scholarship. Physics figures are only in the PDF information sheet.
funding.quote: Should any funded places become available due to withdrawals, the following candidates may apply for such vacant places: applicants awarded a place without a scholarship

also.quote: the places and scholarships made available

entry_route.value: Master's degree required, plus passing the annual admission exam
entry_route.quote: You can access the PhD programme, which lasts 3 or 4 years, only after obtaining a master's degree and passing an admission examination, which is announced annually.

notes: Apply on pica.cineca.it. The 42nd-cycle Physics information sheet (PDF, checked) lists 24 positions, 1 without scholarship, admission exam in Italian or English at the candidate's choice, and English assessed at the oral exam. No Physics-specific IELTS, TOEFL, GRE or fee rule is stated. The 43rd-cycle call is not yet published. 531 PhD positions university-wide for 2026/27.
